description: Fetch a single presentation by its session number (optionally disambiguated by series). Session numbers are VCN-only; non-VCN talks (ClawCamp, standalone Talks) have no session_no — discover those via ic_presentations_list (filter series='ClawCamp'). No auth required. Returns the full ingest-friendly record. Args: { session_no: number, series?: string }. Returns: { scaffold, presentation: { session_no, series, title, date, format, public_url, deployed, speaker?, event?, summary?, content? } } where `content` is the talk's full curated llms.txt distillation (present for decks that ship one — read it instead of fetching the deck). On a miss, an error listing the available { series #session_no } entries. If session_no alone is ambiguous across series, the newest match wins — pass `series` to target one exactly.

series.description: Optional series to disambiguate when the same session_no exists in multiple programs (e.g. a VCN #1 and a ClawCamp #1).

session_no.description: The session number within its series (from ic_presentations_list).

name: ic_presentations_get

outputSchema.description: The tool's JSON result. Every field the tool's description names is present at the top level; ok, error and error_kind follow the shared envelope.

error.description: Why the call failed, in a sentence a person can act on. Present only when ok is false.

error_kind.description: Machine-readable failure class: no_token, missing_scope, forbidden, not_found, invalid_input, rate_limited or transient

ok.description: true when the call did what it was asked; false with `error` and `error_kind` when it did not

result.description: The tool's value when it returns a list or a single value instead of an object

text.description: The tool's reply when it returns plain text instead of JSON

title: Get one Immersive Commons presentation by session (public)
